passages.text: After a long time, in the third year of the drought, the word of the LORD came to Elijah: “Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain upon the face of the earth.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
There was a drought in the land for three years.
A long time passed.
The word of the LORD came to Elijah.
The LORD spoke to Elijah in the third year of the drought.
The LORD said, “Go.
Show yourself to Ahab.
I will send rain on the land.”
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית לֵאמֹ֑ר לֵ֚ךְ הֵרָאֵ֣ה אֶל־ אַחְאָ֔ב וְאֶתְּנָ֥ה מָטָ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria, and Ahab summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of the palace. (Now Obadiah greatly feared the LORD, for when Jezebel had slaughtered the prophets of the LORD, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them, fifty men per cave, providing them with food and water.)
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah went to present himself to Ahab.
Ahab was the king of Israel.
There was a severe famine in Samaria.
Ahab summoned Obadiah.
Obadiah was in charge of the palace.
Obadiah greatly feared the LORD.
Jezebel was the wife of Ahab.
Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD.
Obadiah took one hundred prophets of the LORD.
Obadiah hid the prophets in caves.
He put fifty prophets in each cave.
Obadiah gave them bread and water.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ לְהֵרָא֖וֹת אֶל־ אַחְאָ֑ב וְהָרָעָ֖ב חָזָ֥ק בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃ וַיִּקְרָ֣א אַחְאָ֔ב אֶל־ עֹבַדְיָ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַבָּ֑יִת וְעֹבַדְיָ֗הוּ הָיָ֥ה יָרֵ֛א אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃ וַיְהִי֙ בְּהַכְרִ֣ית אִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֖ת נְבִיאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֨ח עֹבַדְיָ֜הוּ מֵאָ֣ה נְבִאִ֗ים וַֽיַּחְבִּיאֵ֞ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה וְכִלְכְּלָ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם וָמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Then Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go throughout the land to every spring and every valley. Perhaps we will find grass to keep the horses and mules alive so that we will not have to destroy any livestock.”
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel during a severe famine.
Obadiah was in charge of Ahab’s palace.
Ahab spoke to Obadiah.
Ahab said, “Go through the land.”
Ahab told Obadiah to visit every spring of water.
Ahab told Obadiah to visit every valley.
Ahab said, “Perhaps we will find grass.”
Ahab wanted to keep the horses alive.
Ahab wanted to keep the mules alive.
Ahab did not want to destroy any of the livestock.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֶל־ עֹ֣בַדְיָ֔הוּ לֵ֤ךְ בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ מַעְיְנֵ֣י הַמַּ֔יִם וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־ הַנְּחָלִ֑ים אוּלַ֣י׀ נִמְצָ֣א חָצִ֗יר וּנְחַיֶּה֙ ס֣וּס וָפֶ֔רֶד וְל֥וֹא נַכְרִ֖ית מֵהַבְּהֵמָֽה׃

passages.text: So they divided the land to explore. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went the other way by himself.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Obadiah was in charge of Ahab’s palace.
There was a severe famine in Samaria.
Ahab and Obadiah needed to find grass for the animals.
They decided to search the land.
They divided the land between them.
Ahab went in one direction alone.
Obadiah went in another direction alone.
passages.original: וַֽיְחַלְּק֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לַֽעֲבָר־ בָּ֑הּ אַחְאָ֞ב הָלַ֨ךְ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְעֹֽבַדְיָ֛הוּ הָלַ֥ךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ־ אֶחָ֖ד לְבַדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now as Obadiah went on his way, Elijah suddenly met him. When Obadiah recognized him, he fell facedown and said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
passages.sermon:
Obadiah was a servant of King Ahab.
Obadiah was walking on the road.
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah came to meet Obadiah.
Obadiah saw Elijah.
Obadiah recognized Elijah.
Obadiah fell with his face to the ground.
Obadiah said, “Is it you, my lord Elijah?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י עֹבַדְיָ֙הוּ֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְהִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ לִקְרָאת֑וֹ וַיַּכִּרֵ֙הוּ֙ וַיִּפֹּ֣ל עַל־ פָּנָ֔יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הַאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה אֲדֹנִ֥י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: “It is I,” he answered. “Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here!’ ”
passages.sermon:
Elijah spoke to Obadiah.
Elijah said, “I am Elijah.”
Elijah told Obadiah, “Go to your master.”
Elijah said, “Tell your master, ‘Elijah is here.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ אָ֑נִי לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַאדֹנֶ֖יךָ הִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: But Obadiah replied, “How have I sinned, that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to put me to death?
passages.sermon:
Obadiah spoke to Elijah.
Obadiah was a servant of Ahab.
Obadiah feared the LORD from his youth.
Obadiah said, “What sin have I done?”
Obadiah asked, “Why are you giving me to Ahab?”
Obadiah said, “Ahab will kill me.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה חָטָ֑אתִי כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֞ה נֹתֵ֧ן אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֛ בְּיַד־ אַחְאָ֖ב לַהֲמִיתֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: As surely as the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent someone to search for you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he made that kingdom or nation swear that they had not found you.
passages.sermon:
Obadiah spoke to Elijah.
Obadiah served King Ahab.
Obadiah said, "As surely as the LORD your God lives, I speak the truth."
Ahab is my master.
Ahab sent people to every nation and kingdom.
Ahab ordered them to search for you, Elijah.
No nation or kingdom was left out.
When the people said, 'Elijah is not here,' Ahab did not believe them.
Ahab made that nation or kingdom swear an oath.
They had to promise they had not found you, Elijah.
passages.original: חַ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אִם־ יֶשׁ־ גּ֤וֹי וּמַמְלָכָה֙ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ שָׁלַ֨ח אֲדֹנִ֥י שָׁם֙ לְבַקֶּשְׁךָ֔ וְאָמְר֖וּ אָ֑יִן וְהִשְׁבִּ֤יעַ אֶת־ הַמַּמְלָכָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַגּ֔וֹי כִּ֖י לֹ֥א יִמְצָאֶֽכָּה׃

passages.text: And now you say, ‘Go tell your master that Elijah is here!’
passages.sermon:
Obadiah spoke to Elijah.
Obadiah was a servant of King Ahab.
Obadiah feared the LORD from his youth.
Obadiah said, "Now you tell me to go."
You tell me to say to my master, Ahab, 'Elijah is here.'
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֑ר לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַאדֹנֶ֖יךָ הִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: I do not know where the Spirit of the LORD may carry you off when I leave you. Then when I go and tell Ahab and he does not find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.
passages.sermon:
I am your servant.
I have feared the LORD since I was young.
If I leave you, I do not know where the Spirit of the LORD might take you.
If I go and tell Ahab, and he does not find you, he will kill me.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֞ה אֲנִ֣י׀ אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵאִתָּ֗ךְ וְר֨וּחַ יְהוָ֤ה׀ יִֽשָּׂאֲךָ֙ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ אֵדָ֔ע וּבָ֨אתִי לְהַגִּ֧יד לְאַחְאָ֛ב וְלֹ֥א יִֽמְצָאֲךָ֖ וַהֲרָגָ֑נִי וְעַבְדְּךָ֛ יָרֵ֥א אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה מִנְּעֻרָֽי׃

passages.text: Was it not reported to my lord what I did when Jezebel slaughtered the prophets of the LORD? I hid a hundred prophets of the LORD, fifty men per cave, and I provided them with food and water.
passages.sermon:
Obadiah served Ahab as his steward.
Obadiah feared the LORD from his youth.
Jezebel killed the prophets of the LORD.
Obadiah acted to save the prophets.
Obadiah hid one hundred prophets of the LORD.
He placed fifty prophets in each cave.
Obadiah gave them bread and water.
People reported these actions to Ahab.
passages.original: הֲלֹֽא־ הֻגַּ֤ד לַֽאדֹנִי֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֔יתִי בַּהֲרֹ֣ג אִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֖ת נְבִיאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וָאַחְבִּא֩ מִנְּבִיאֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה מֵ֣אָה אִ֗ישׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה וָאֲכַלְכְּלֵ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם וָמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord that Elijah is here!’ He will kill me!”
passages.sermon:
Obadiah spoke to Elijah.
Obadiah served King Ahab.
Obadiah feared the LORD from his youth.
Obadiah said, “Now you tell me, ‘Go, say to your master, Elijah is here.’
If I do this, Ahab will kill me.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּה֙ אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֔ר לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַֽאדֹנֶ֖יךָ הִנֵּ֣ה אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַהֲרָגָֽנִי׃ס

passages.text: Then Elijah said, “As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will present myself to Ahab today.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD is the LORD of Hosts.
Elijah stood before the LORD.
Elijah spoke.
Elijah said, “The LORD of Hosts lives.
I stand before Him.
Today I will present myself to Ahab.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ חַ֚י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָמַ֖דְתִּי לְפָנָ֑יו כִּ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם אֵרָאֶ֥ה אֵלָֽיו׃

passages.text: So Obadiah went to inform Ahab, who went to meet Elijah.
passages.sermon:
Obadiah was a servant of King Ahab.
Obadiah went to find Ahab.
Obadiah told Ahab what Elijah had said.
Ahab then went to meet Elijah.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ עֹבַדְיָ֛הוּ לִקְרַ֥את אַחְאָ֖ב וַיַּגֶּד־ ל֑וֹ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחְאָ֖ב לִקְרַ֥את אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: When Ahab saw Elijah, he said to him, “Is that you, O troubler of Israel?”
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Ahab saw Elijah.
Ahab spoke to Elijah.
Ahab said, “Is that you, troubler of Israel?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י כִּרְא֥וֹת אַחְאָ֖ב אֶת־ אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֵלָ֔יו הַאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה עֹכֵ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: “I have not troubled Israel,” Elijah replied, “but you and your father’s house have, for you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD and have followed the Baals.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab accused Elijah of troubling Israel.
Elijah replied to Ahab.
Elijah said, “I have not troubled Israel.
You have troubled Israel.
Your father’s house has troubled Israel.
You have abandoned the commandments of the LORD.
You have followed the Baals.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֹ֤א עָכַ֙רְתִּי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י אִם־ אַתָּ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ בַּֽעֲזָבְכֶם֙ אֶת־ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַבְּעָלִֽים׃

passages.text: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
He spoke to King Ahab.
Elijah said, “Send for all the people of Israel.
Gather them to me at Mount Carmel.
Bring the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal.
Bring the four hundred prophets of Asherah.
These prophets eat at Jezebel’s table.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שְׁלַ֨ח קְבֹ֥ץ אֵלַ֛י אֶת־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וְאֶת־ נְבִיאֵ֨י הַבַּ֜עַל אַרְבַּ֧ע מֵא֣וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וּנְבִיאֵ֤י הָֽאֲשֵׁרָה֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת אֹכְלֵ֖י שֻׁלְחַ֥ן אִיזָֽבֶל׃

passages.text: So Ahab summoned all the Israelites and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab sent messengers throughout all Israel.
Ahab gathered all the Israelites.
Ahab assembled the prophets.
Ahab brought them to Mount Carmel.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח אַחְאָ֖ב בְּכָל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּקְבֹּ֥ץ אֶת־ הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֶל־ הַ֥ר הַכַּרְמֶֽל׃

passages.text: Then Elijah approached all the people and said, “How long will you waver between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow Him. But if Baal is God, follow him.” But the people did not answer a word.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah came near to all the people.
He spoke to them.
He said, "How long will you waver between two opinions?"
He said, "If the LORD is God, follow Him."
He said, "If Baal is God, follow him."
The people did not answer Elijah.
They said nothing.
passages.original: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ עַד־ מָתַ֞י אַתֶּ֣ם פֹּסְחִים֮ עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַסְּעִפִּים֒ אִם־ יְהוָ֤ה הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְכ֣וּ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְאִם־ הַבַּ֖עַל לְכ֣וּ אַחֲרָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־ עָנ֥וּ הָעָ֛ם אֹת֖וֹ דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: Then Elijah said to the people, “I am the only remaining prophet of the LORD, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah spoke to all the people.
Elijah said, "I am the only prophet of the LORD who remains."
Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם אֲנִ֞י נוֹתַ֧רְתִּי נָבִ֛יא לַיהוָ֖ה לְבַדִּ֑י וּנְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֔עַל אַרְבַּע־ מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: Get two bulls for us. Let the prophets of Baal choose one bull for themselves, cut it into pieces, and place it on the wood but not light the fire. And I will prepare the other bull and place it on the wood but not light the fire.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
He spoke to all the people.
He said, “Bring two bulls for us.”
Let the prophets of Baal choose one bull for themselves.
Let them cut the bull into pieces.
Let them place the pieces on the wood.
They must not light the fire.
I will prepare the other bull.
I will place it on the wood.
I will not light the fire.
passages.original: וְיִתְּנוּ־ לָ֜נוּ שְׁנַ֣יִם פָּרִ֗ים וְיִבְחֲר֣וּ לָהֶם֩ הַפָּ֨ר הָאֶחָ֜ד וִֽינַתְּחֻ֗הוּ וְיָשִׂ֙ימוּ֙ עַל־ הָ֣עֵצִ֔ים וְאֵ֖שׁ לֹ֣א יָשִׂ֑ימוּ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה׀ אֶת־ הַפָּ֣ר הָאֶחָ֗ד וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ עַל־ הָ֣עֵצִ֔ים וְאֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א אָשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: Then you may call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the LORD. The God who answers by fire, He is God.” And all the people answered, “What you say is good.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah spoke to the people.
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
He said, "You will call on the name of your god."
He said, "I will call on the name of the LORD."
He said, "The God who answers by fire is the true God."
All the people answered.
They said, "What you say is good."
passages.original: וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א בְשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֧ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲנֶ֥ה בָאֵ֖שׁ ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֧עַן כָּל־ הָעָ֛ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ ט֥וֹב הַדָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, “Since you are so numerous, choose for yourselves one bull and prepare it first. Then call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
He spoke to the prophets of Baal.
He said, "You are many."
"Choose one bull for yourselves."
"Prepare the bull first."
"Call on the name of your god."
"Do not put fire to the offering."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ לִנְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֗עַל בַּחֲר֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם הַפָּ֤ר הָֽאֶחָד֙ וַעֲשׂ֣וּ רִאשֹׁנָ֔ה כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֖ם הָרַבִּ֑ים וְקִרְאוּ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א תָשִֽׂימוּ׃

passages.text: And they took the bull that was given them, prepared it, and called on the name of Baal from morning until noon, shouting, “O Baal, answer us!” But there was no sound, and no one answered as they leaped around the altar they had made.
passages.sermon:
The prophets of Baal took the bull that Elijah gave them.
They prepared the bull for sacrifice.
They called on the name of Baal from morning until noon.
They shouted, “Baal, answer us!”
No one answered them.
No sound came from Baal.
They leaped around the altar they had made.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּקְחוּ אֶת־ הַפָּ֨ר אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶם֮ וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֒ וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ בְשֵׁם־ הַ֠בַּעַל מֵהַבֹּ֨קֶר וְעַד־ הַצָּהֳרַ֤יִם לֵאמֹר֙ הַבַּ֣עַל עֲנֵ֔נוּ וְאֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל וְאֵ֣ין עֹנֶ֑ה וַֽיְפַסְּח֔וּ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: At noon Elijah began to taunt them, saying, “Shout louder, for he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or occupied, or on a journey. Perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened!”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
The prophets of Baal tried to call on their god.
At noon, Elijah mocked them.
Elijah said, "Shout louder."
He said, "He is a god."
He said, "Maybe he is thinking."
He said, "Maybe he is busy."
He said, "Maybe he is traveling."
He said, "Maybe he is sleeping."
He said, "Maybe he needs to be awakened."
passages.original: וַיְהִ֨י בַֽצָּהֳרַ֜יִם וַיְהַתֵּ֧ל בָּהֶ֣ם אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ קִרְא֤וּ בְקוֹל־ גָּדוֹל֙ כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים ה֔וּא כִּ֣י שִׂ֧יחַ וְכִֽי־ שִׂ֛יג ל֖וֹ וְכִֽי־ דֶ֣רֶךְ ל֑וֹ אוּלַ֛י יָשֵׁ֥ן ה֖וּא וְיִקָֽץ׃

passages.text: So they shouted louder and cut themselves with knives and lances, as was their custom, until the blood gushed over them.
passages.sermon:
The prophets of Baal shouted with loud voices.
They cut themselves with knives and lances.
This was their custom.
Blood flowed over them.
passages.original: וַֽיִּקְרְאוּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל וַיִּתְגֹּֽדְדוּ֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם בַּחֲרָב֖וֹת וּבָֽרְמָחִ֑ים עַד־ שְׁפָךְ־ דָּ֖ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Midday passed, and they kept on raving until the time of the evening sacrifice. But there was no response; no one answered, no one paid attention.
passages.sermon:
Midday passed.
The prophets of Baal kept raving.
They raved until the time of the evening sacrifice.
No one responded to them.
No one answered them.
No one paid attention to them.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כַּעֲבֹ֣ר הַֽצָּהֳרַ֔יִם וַיִּֽתְנַבְּא֔וּ עַ֖ד לַעֲל֣וֹת הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְאֵֽין־ ק֥וֹל וְאֵין־ עֹנֶ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין קָֽשֶׁב׃

passages.text: Then Elijah said to all the people, “Come near to me.” So all the people approached him, and he repaired the altar of the LORD that had been torn down.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah spoke to all the people.
He said, “Come near to me.”
All the people came close to Elijah.
The altar of the LORD was broken down.
Elijah repaired the altar of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֤הוּ לְכָל־ הָעָם֙ גְּשׁ֣וּ אֵלַ֔י וַיִּגְּשׁ֥וּ כָל־ הָעָ֖ם אֵלָ֑יו וַיְרַפֵּ֛א אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה הֶהָרֽוּס׃

passages.text: And Elijah took twelve stones, one for each tribe of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come and said, “Israel shall be your name.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah took twelve stones.
Each stone stood for one tribe of the sons of Jacob.
The LORD had spoken to Jacob.
The LORD said to Jacob, “Israel shall be your name.”
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים כְּמִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: And with the stones, Elijah built an altar in the name of the LORD. Then he dug a trench around the altar large enough to hold two seahs of seed.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah took the stones.
He built an altar with the stones.
He built the altar in the name of the LORD.
Elijah dug a trench around the altar.
The trench was large.
The trench could hold two seahs of seed.
passages.original: וַיִּבְנֶ֧ה אֶת־ הָאֲבָנִ֛ים מִזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּ֣עַשׂ תְּעָלָ֗ה כְּבֵית֙ סָאתַ֣יִם זֶ֔רַע סָבִ֖יב לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: Next, he arranged the wood, cut up the bull, placed it on the wood, and said, “Fill four waterpots and pour the water on the offering and on the wood.” “Do it a second time,” he said, and they did it a second time. “Do it a third time,” he said, and they did it a third time.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah arranged the wood.
He cut the bull into pieces.
He placed the pieces of the bull on the wood.
Elijah said, “Fill four waterpots with water.”
He said, “Pour the water on the offering and on the wood.”
He said, “Do it a second time.”
They did it a second time.
He said, “Do it a third time.”
They did it a third time.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־ הָֽעֵצִ֑ים וַיְנַתַּח֙ אֶת־ הַפָּ֔ר וַיָּ֖שֶׂם עַל־ הָעֵצִֽים׃ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִלְא֨וּ אַרְבָּעָ֤ה כַדִּים֙ מַ֔יִם וְיִֽצְק֥וּ עַל־ הָעֹלָ֖ה וְעַל־ הָעֵצִ֑ים וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁנוּ֙ וַיִּשְׁנ֔וּ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שַׁלֵּ֖שׁוּ וַיְשַׁלֵּֽשׁוּ׃

passages.text: So the water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
He built an altar to the LORD.
He poured water on the altar and on the wood.
The water flowed around the altar.
The water filled the trench around the altar.
passages.original: וַיֵּלְכ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם סָבִ֖יב לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ הַתְּעָלָ֖ה מִלֵּא־ מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: At the time of the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet approached the altar and said, “O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that You are God in Israel and that I am Your servant and have done all these things at Your command.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet in Israel.
It was the time of the evening sacrifice.
Elijah approached the altar.
He spoke to the LORD.
He said, “LORD, You are the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel.
Let everyone know today that You are God in Israel.
Let them know that I am Your servant.
I have done all these things because You commanded me.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּעֲל֣וֹת הַמִּנְחָ֗ה וַיִּגַּ֞שׁ אֵלִיָּ֣הוּ הַנָּבִיא֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיּ֣וֹם יִוָּדַ֗ע כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַאֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וּבְדִבְרֶיךָ עָשִׂ֔יתִי אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Answer me, O LORD! Answer me, so that this people will know that You, the LORD, are God, and that You have turned their hearts back again.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah prayed to God at the altar.
Elijah said, "Answer me, LORD.
Answer me."
Elijah wanted the people to know something.
He wanted them to know that the LORD is God.
He wanted them to know that God turned their hearts back to Him.
passages.original: עֲנֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲנֵ֔נִי וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאַתָּ֛ה הֲסִבֹּ֥תָ אֶת־ לִבָּ֖ם אֲחֹרַנִּֽית׃

passages.text: Then the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, and the dust, and it licked up the water in the trench.
passages.sermon:
The LORD sent fire from heaven.
The fire fell onto the altar.
The fire burned up the sacrifice.
The fire burned up the wood.
The fire burned up the stones.
The fire burned up the dust.
The fire dried up the water in the trench.
passages.original: וַתִּפֹּ֣ל אֵשׁ־ יְהוָ֗ה וַתֹּ֤אכַל אֶת־ הָֽעֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣עֵצִ֔ים וְאֶת־ הָאֲבָנִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הֶעָפָ֑ר וְאֶת־ הַמַּ֥יִם אֲשֶׁר־ בַּתְּעָלָ֖ה לִחֵֽכָה׃

passages.text: When all the people saw this, they fell facedown and said, “The LORD, He is God! The LORD, He is God!”
passages.sermon:
All the people saw what happened.
They saw the fire of the LORD fall and consume the sacrifice.
They saw the fire burn the wood, the stones, the dust, and the water in the trench.
The people fell facedown on the ground.
They said, “The LORD is God.”
They said again, “The LORD is God.”
passages.original: וַיַּרְא֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהוָ֖ה ה֥וּא הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Elijah ordered them, “Seize the prophets of Baal! Do not let a single one escape.” So they seized them, and Elijah brought them down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered them there.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah spoke to the people.
He said, “Seize the prophets of Baal.”
He said, “Do not let a single one escape.”
The people seized the prophets of Baal.
Elijah led the prophets of Baal down to the Kishon Valley.
Elijah killed the prophets of Baal there.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ לָהֶ֜ם תִּפְשׂ֣וּ׀ אֶת־ נְבִיאֵ֣י הַבַּ֗עַל אִ֛ישׁ אַל־ יִמָּלֵ֥ט מֵהֶ֖ם וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂ֑וּם וַיּוֹרִדֵ֤ם אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ נַ֣חַל קִישׁ֔וֹן וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֖ם שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Elijah spoke to Ahab.
Elijah said, “Go up.
Eat.
Drink.
I hear the sound of a heavy rain.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֙הוּ֙ לְאַחְאָ֔ב עֲלֵ֖ה אֱכֹ֣ל וּשְׁתֵ֑ה כִּי־ ק֖וֹל הֲמ֥וֹן הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃

passages.text: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. But Elijah climbed to the summit of Carmel, bent down on the ground, and put his face between his knees.
passages.sermon:
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab went up to eat.
Ahab went up to drink.
Elijah was a prophet of the Lord.
Elijah climbed to the top of Mount Carmel.
Elijah bent down to the ground.
Elijah put his face between his knees.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲלֶ֥ה אַחְאָ֖ב לֶאֱכֹ֣ל וְלִשְׁתּ֑וֹת וְאֵ֨לִיָּ֜הוּ עָלָ֨ה אֶל־ רֹ֤אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל֙ וַיִּגְהַ֣ר אַ֔רְצָה וַיָּ֥שֶׂם פָּנָ֖יו בֵּ֥ין בְּרָכוֹ׃

passages.text: “Go and look toward the sea,” he said to his servant. So the servant went and looked, and he said, “There is nothing there.” Seven times Elijah said, “Go back.”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah spoke to his servant.
Elijah said, “Go and look toward the sea.”
The servant went.
The servant looked toward the sea.
The servant said, “There is nothing there.”
Elijah said, “Go back.”
Elijah told him to go back seven times.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל־ נַעֲר֗וֹ עֲלֵֽה־ נָא֙ הַבֵּ֣ט דֶּֽרֶךְ־ יָ֔ם וַיַּ֙עַל֙ וַיַּבֵּ֔ט וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵ֣ין מְא֑וּמָה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שֻׁ֖ב שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃

passages.text: On the seventh time the servant reported, “There is a cloud as small as a man’s hand rising from the sea.” And Elijah replied, “Go and tell Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
Elijah had a servant with him.
The servant looked toward the sea.
On the seventh time, the servant spoke.
He said, “There is a small cloud.”
The cloud was as small as a man’s hand.
The cloud was rising from the sea.
Elijah spoke to his servant.
He said, “Go to Ahab.”
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Elijah said, “Tell Ahab to prepare his chariot.”
Elijah said, “Tell him to go down.”
Elijah said, “Tell him to go before the rain stops him.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּשְּׁבִעִ֔ית וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה־ עָ֛ב קְטַנָּ֥ה כְּכַף־ אִ֖ישׁ עֹלָ֣ה מִיָּ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר עֲלֵ֨ה אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל־ אַחְאָב֙ אֱסֹ֣ר וָרֵ֔ד וְלֹ֥א יַעַצָרְכָ֖ה הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃

passages.text: Meanwhile, the sky grew dark with clouds and wind, and a heavy rain began to fall. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
passages.sermon:
The sky became dark.
Clouds covered the sky.
The wind blew strongly.
Heavy rain began to fall.
Ahab was the king of Israel.
Ahab got into his chariot.
Ahab rode to Jezreel.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ עַד־ כֹּ֣ה וְעַד־ כֹּ֗ה וְהַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ הִֽתְקַדְּרוּ֙ עָבִ֣ים וְר֔וּחַ וַיְהִ֖י גֶּ֣שֶׁם גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב אַחְאָ֖ב וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ יִזְרְעֶֽאלָה׃

passages.text: And the hand of the LORD came upon Elijah, and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.
passages.sermon:
Elijah was a prophet of the LORD.
The hand of the LORD came upon Elijah.
Elijah tucked his cloak into his belt.
Elijah ran ahead of Ahab.
Elijah ran all the way to Jezreel.
passages.original: וְיַד־ יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ וַיְשַׁנֵּ֖ס מָתְנָ֑יו וַיָּ֙רָץ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אַחְאָ֔ב עַד־ בֹּאֲכָ֖ה יִזְרְעֶֽאלָה׃
